app.name: BIMCraft
language.label: Language
panel.consoleEmpty: The console will run Python scripts in a later version.
georef.loadError: The project location could not be read.
georef.location.title: Project location
georef.location.intro: This project is not placed on Earth yet. Choose a coordinate system, then say where the model origin (0, 0, 0) is on the map.
georef.crs.label: Coordinate system
georef.crs.help: The map system used by your survey, for example Lambert 93 (EPSG 2154) or a CC zone (CC42–CC50). Search by code or name.
georef.crs.placeholder: Search by code or name, e.g. 2154 or Lambert
georef.crs.loadError: The list of coordinate systems could not be loaded.
georef.base.title: Project base point
georef.base.help: The map coordinates of the model's origin (0, 0, 0), in metres.
georef.orientation.title: Orientation
georef.rotation.label: Grid rotation
georef.rotation.help: The angle between the map grid and your project grid, counter-clockwise. 0 means the project axes follow the map.
georef.format.label: Angle format
georef.north.diagram: Project north, grid north and true north
georef.trueNorth.help: Computed from the meridian convergence at the base point and the grid rotation.
georef.scale.label: Scale
georef.scale.help: Leave at 1 unless your surveyor gave you a project scale.
georef.survey.title: Survey point (optional)
georef.survey.help: The map coordinates of a known benchmark, in metres. Leave empty if you have none.
georef.survey.local: Position in the model: x {x} · y {y} · z {z}
georef.derived.title: Derived information
georef.remove.title: Remove the georeference?
georef.remove.body: The model stays as it is; only its place on Earth is forgotten.
georef.error.survey: Enter all three survey values, or leave all empty.
georef.error.unknown_crs: This coordinate system is not available.
georef.error.not_projected: Choose a projected system (map coordinates in metres), not latitude/longitude.
georef.error.invalid_scale: The scale must be between 0.000001 and 1000000.
georef.error.outside_domain: This point is outside the area where this coordinate system is valid. Check the numbers or the system.
georef.error.multiple_sites: This project has several sites. Georeferencing needs exactly one.
georef.error.not_georeferenced: The project has no location yet.
georef.panel.empty: This project has no location yet. Place it on a coordinate system to read and enter map and latitude/longitude coordinates.
georef.panel.pickDisabled: Available when the 3D view is ready.
georef.block.heightApprox: Height is approximate: there is no geoid model yet.
georef.convert.outside: This point is too far from the projection to convert.
